items.text:
Northwind Solar Farm - Project Brief
This brief summarises the Northwind Solar Farm project for the steering committee.
The project is sponsored by the Halden County Energy Cooperative.
The site is located 12 kilometres north of the town of Marlow.

2. Capacity and technology
The farm will have an installed capacity of 48 megawatts.
It will use 96,000 bifacial panels mounted on single-axis trackers.
Expected annual generation is 82 gigawatt-hours.

3. Budget
The total capital budget is 41.5 million euros.
The steering committee approved the budget on 4 March 2026.
A contingency reserve of 3.2 million euros is included in the total.

4. Schedule
Construction is planned to start in June 2026.
Grid connection is targeted for the second quarter of 2027.
The main construction contractor is Brightline Builders.

5. Environment
A 15-metre hedgerow buffer will surround the site to protect local wildlife.
Sheep grazing will be used to manage vegetation between panel rows.

6. Community
Residents of Marlow will receive a 10 percent discount on electricity tariffs.
A community fund will receive 50,000 euros per year from project revenue.

body.summary_short: The Northwind Solar Farm project aims to install a 48 MW solar facility near Marlow, with a budget of 41.5 million euros and a focus on community benefits and environmental protection.
body.summary_detailed: The Northwind Solar Farm project, sponsored by the Halden County Energy Cooperative, is located 12 kilometers north of Marlow. It will feature an installed capacity of 48 megawatts using 96,000 bifacial panels on single-axis trackers, generating an expected 82 gigawatt-hours annually. The total capital budget is 41.5 million euros, approved on 4 March 2026, including a 3.2 million euro contingency reserve. Construction is set to begin in June 2026, with grid connection planned for the second quarter of 2027, led by Brightline Builders. Environmental measures include a 15-meter hedgerow buffer and sheep grazing for vegetation management. Additionally, Marlow residents will benefit from a 10 percent discount on electricity tariffs, and a community fund will receive 50,000 euros annually from project revenue.

key_points.text: The Northwind Solar Farm project is sponsored by the Halden County Energy Cooperative.
The solar farm will have an installed capacity of 48 megawatts using 96,000 bifacial panels.
Expected annual generation from the solar farm is 82 gigawatt-hours.
The total capital budget for the project is 41.5 million euros, approved on 4 March 2026.
Construction is planned to start in June 2026, with grid connection targeted for the second quarter of 2027.
Brightline Builders is the main construction contractor for the project.
A 15-meter hedgerow buffer will surround the site to protect local wildlife.
Residents of Marlow will receive a 10 percent discount on electricity tariffs due to the project.
A community fund will receive 50,000 euros per year from project revenue.
